BiblicalUsage: Hezekiah's messengers call the day a day of trouble and of rebuke and of blasphemy, and the LORD says He has heard all the blasphemies spoken against the mountains of Israel. The same words are prayed in Isaiah, and Nehemiah remembers the great provocations of the golden calf.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe blasphemy is the sin that names God falsely: the Assyrian mocks Him, the calf-makers replace Him, and the faithful answer by carrying the insult to the LORD Himself. The insult is carried to the LORD, and the LORD answers it — and that is where I must take every word spoken against Him.
